title: Gym web page photos can show members' faces with no check that those people agreed
what: The owner adds up to a set number of gym photos to a public page that Google may list. The only tick says the fees, photos and words are the gym's own. Nothing asks whether people seen in the photos agreed to be shown, and the tick is asked only once, at first publish, so photos added later are never covered.
expected: Before publishing photos, the owner is told to use photos where any person shown has agreed (or shows no faces), and the promise covers photos added later.
how_often: every gym that publishes a page with people in its photos
fix_line: Add one line under Photos and in the tick: only photos where anyone shown has agreed to be on the page

items.reason: These screens are the owner's web panel; nothing here ships as an iPhone app or through the App Store, and paying MettleUp is by UPI or bank transfer on the web
